description: This script processes Valgrind XML output files in a specified directory, summarizes error counts, and writes the results to a CSV file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that creates a CSV report of Valgrind errors by parsing XML files in the output directory.

methods.name: ParseGtestXml
methods.description: Parses a Valgrind XML file to count different types of errors and determine if the test failed.
